spec.description: Acoustic Timber Ceiling Tile is a high-performance acoustic tile made from non-woven, needle punched 100% polyester fibre, designed for ceiling applications and compliant with standard grid systems.
spec.sustainability: Carbon neutral, Zero waste manufacturing, Anti-modern slavery
install: Install as per Autex Acoustics recommendations
Install instructions included in each pack or available on the website
Adhere to relevant building codes and design rules near fire protection systems
limitations: Avoid contact with the Acoustic Timber Ceiling Tile surface
Gently remove liquids and contaminants immediately
Do not allow liquids to soak, dry, or set
Refer to product Care and Maintenance for cleaning guidance
Consult a specialist cleaning company if required
All loads to be independently supported or transferred to the grid

Specification
Acoustic Timber™  Ceiling Tile is a simple, high-performance 
acoustic tile made from Accent Ceiling Tile™  designed to fit within 
standard grid systems and comply with typical loading standards. 
Made from non-woven, needle punched 100% polyester fibre, the 
tiles are lightweight and sturdy, so they will not chip, crack, or break.
